id: \bLiving out in the wild like this isn't easy. I'm sure you've run into a lot of wild Pokémon.
en: \bLiving out in the wild like this isn't easy. I'm sure you've run into a lot of wild Pokémon.
it: \bVivere così in mezzo alla natura non è facile. Sono sicuro che ti sarai imbattuto in un sacco di Pokémon selvatici.

id: \bThese might help you out. Take some.
en: \bThese might help you out. Take some.
it: \bQuesti potrebbero esserti utili. Prendine un po'.

id: \bMax Repel will help drive away wild Pokémon. Don't worry about taking them. I have many stored up.
en: \bMax Repel will help drive away wild Pokémon. Don't worry about taking them. I have many stored up.
it: \bIl Repellente Max ti aiuterà a tenere lontani i Pokémon selvatici. Prendili pure senza problemi. Ne ho una bella scorta.
